title: Migrate toolchain to Vite+ (fmt, lint, hooks, CI, vitest)
description: Move dev/build/typecheck to Vite+ and adopt its formatter, linter, git hooks, GitHub Actions and Vitest. Formatter config mirrors shadcn-ui/ui conventions, plus Tailwind class sorting for our code. Vendored registry/shadcn/** must stay byte-identical to upstream: exclude it from class sorting, or from formatting entirely if partial exclusion isn't possible.
acceptance_criteria: vp fmt --check, lint, typecheck, test and build pass locally and in CI; a pre-commit hook runs the checks; registry/shadcn files unchanged after formatting (re-vendor produces no diff).
close_reason: Vite+ 1.8: vp check (oxfmt w/ shadcn options + import groups + tailwind sorting, oxlint react/a11y/vitest + type-aware), vp test (browser mode, system Chrome, 5 tests), vp build (incl. registry), pre-commit vp staged chained in .beads/hooks, CI + dependabot. Vendored registry/shadcn byte-identical (sorting disabled via override; vendor.ts guards).

title: Scaffold registry source layout + build script
description: Per docs/registry-research.md: registry/bases/{radix,base,aria}/, root registry.json, scripts/build that emits public/r/<base>-<style>/<name>.json for all 24 combos + legacy new-york-v4/new-york/default (radix). Uses shadcn build under the hood. Same file for all 8 styles initially.
acceptance_criteria: Build produces JSON for every combo; npx shadcn registry validate passes; a local {style}-templated install into a test app works for radix, base and aria styles.
close_reason: Layout + scripts/build.ts (per-style cn-* resolution, 24 combos + legacy). Items validated with shadcn registry schemas at build; real CLI installs verified into base/radix/aria test apps.

title: R&D: shadcn GitHub registry + multi-primitive components
description:
Research how to ship Nabil UI as a shadcn registry hosted on GitHub (https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry/github.md), with an eye on later submitting to the registry index (https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry/registry-index.md).

Goal: components must install and behave exactly like official shadcn components:
- Support all 3 headless primitive libraries: Radix UI, Base UI, React Aria — figure out how official shadcn picks the variant (components.json style/base field?) and how a third-party registry can serve per-primitive variants.
- Use the icon library chosen in the consumer's components.json (lucide, tabler, phosphor, etc.) — find out how official components resolve/transform icons at install time.
- Respect other components.json settings (aliases, tailwind css vars, rsc, tsx, style).

Deliverable: written findings (registry.json schema, build step, repo layout, how variants/icons are handled) + a recommended project structure, captured in bd notes or a short doc.
acceptance_criteria: Findings documented; recommended repo layout and build pipeline decided; follow-up implementation issues filed.
notes: Findings: docs/registry-research.md. Decision: namespaced static registry with {style} URL on GitHub Pages (GitHub owner/repo installs can't vary by primitive). Follow-ups: nabil-ui-vbx, nabil-ui-otz, nabil-ui-b3y.

title: multi-view-calendar: decade view 2x5 (10 years)

close_reason: Decade view: 10 years in 2x5 like century; outside-tile code removed. check + 6 tests pass.

title: multi-view-calendar: century 2x5 grid (10 decades), caption looks disabled at top
description: Century view: 5 rows x 2 cols with only the 10 decades (bigger tiles). The century caption button should look disabled (like react-date-picker) so users see they can't go higher.
close_reason: Century view: 10 decades in 2x5 grid; caption shows the buttons' own disabled:opacity-50 at the top level. check + 6 tests pass.

title: multi-view-calendar: centuries/decades start at year 1; try 2-col century grid
description: Century = years 1..100 (2001–2100), so century tiles are decades 2001–2010…; decade view aligned the same (2021–2030). Also try a 2-column grid for century view so the long 'yyyy – yyyy' tiles fit.
close_reason: Decades/centuries start at year 1 (2021–2030, 2001–2100) in all 3 bases; century view uses 2 cols × 6 rows at normal text size; arrow up/down step = column count. check + 6 tests pass.

title: Playground: selected day/tile turns muted on hover
description: Playground imported shadcn style CSS unlayered, so .style-* .cn-button-variant-ghost:hover beat layered utilities like data-[selected]:bg-primary. Official day button showed the same bug; installs were unaffected. shadcn's site imports the style files with layer(base).
close_reason: Style CSS imported with layer(base) like shadcn's site; regression test added (fails without fix).

title: multi-view-calendar: hierarchical month/year/decade/century views (Radix, Base UI, React Aria)
description: Extend shadcn Calendar (month grid only) with hierarchical views like react-date-picker / flowbite / mantine: month (day tiles) → year (month tiles) → decade (year tiles) → century (decade tiles). Clicking the caption goes up one view; selecting a tile goes down one view and navigates there. Month is the lowest view.
design:
Radix + Base UI: MultiViewCalendar has the same props as the official Calendar (react-day-picker DayPicker props + buttonVariant). It wraps the official Calendar (registryDependency 'calendar') through its components prop: MonthCaption becomes a button that goes up a view; the Months wrapper keeps the month grid in the DOM with visibility:hidden and renders the higher-view grid absolute inset-0 inside it, so the calendar size never changes. Navigation uses useDayPicker().goToMonth. The view state is optionally controlled: view / defaultView / onViewChange.
- Radix: onViewChange(view).
- Base UI: onViewChange(view, eventDetails) with full Base UI-style eventDetails { reason, event, cancel(), isCanceled }.
React Aria: the official aria Calendar is built on react-aria-components (no components prop), so we write our own copy of its markup and classes, adding the same view state and hidden-grid overlay. API mirrors the official aria Calendar (DateValue, focusedValue); view / defaultView / onViewChange.
Icons: IconPlaceholder with all 5 props (accepted risk: undocumented).
acceptance_criteria: Installs and works in test apps for radix-*, base-*, aria-* styles and at least two icon libraries.
close_reason: multi-view-calendar for radix, base, aria. Verified in headless Chrome (up/down navigation, focus, size stays fixed, controlled view + Base UI cancel, start/endMonth) and installed via shadcn CLI into base-maia/lucide, radix-maia/hugeicons, aria-maia/tabler apps (tsc + vite build pass).

title: Deploy registry JSON to GitHub Pages
description: GitHub Actions workflow: run build, deploy public/r to GitHub Pages so consumers can use "@nabil": "https://nabilsnigdho.github.io/nabil-ui/r/{style}/{name}.json". GitHub owner/repo/item installs can't pick a primitive (no {style}), hence Pages.
acceptance_criteria: Pages URL serves /r/<combo>/<name>.json; install from a fresh app via the @nabil namespace works.

title: Write README.md and add open-source license
description: Add README.md for Nabil UI (what it is: a small collection of shadcn-based components; install via shadcn CLI from the GitHub registry; component list; supported primitives Radix/Base UI/React Aria; contributing). Add LICENSE file — default MIT (matches shadcn/ui) unless decided otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: README.md and LICENSE exist at repo root; README install instructions match the registry setup from the R&D issue.
